name: Paulmann family
note: The shopkeeper family behind Cencosud. The family's stake is held through the London-registered PK One Limited (52.15% of Cencosud S.A. at 30 June 2026, per Cencosud's own shareholder page); The Clinic reported in May 2023 that PK One was created by the Paulmanns as the new control vehicle, with Horst Paulmann and his three eldest children as its directors.
